canonical_thesis.es: Un sistema hotelero productivo y regulado, varios compartimentos jurídicos de título.
canonical_thesis.en: One regulated hotel productive system, several legally distinct title compartments.

propositions.proposition_es: La finca 8584 no se analiza como apartamento autónomo, sino como título registral integrado en un establecimiento hotelero funcionalmente unitario.
propositions.proposition_en: Finca 8584 is not analysed as an autonomous apartment but as a registered title integrated into a functionally unified hotel establishment.
propositions.missing_discriminator: Certified Registry-Cadastre-as-built-current-room overlay and operator authority

propositions.proposition_es: La titularidad es el anclaje de derechos de propiedad, posesión, acceso, gobernanza, explotación hotelera, contabilidad, prueba y restitución, sujetos a prueba específica.
propositions.proposition_en: Title anchors property, possession, access, governance, hotel-operation, accounting, evidential and restitution rights, subject to specific proof.
propositions.missing_discriminator: Title, contract and statutory right-by-right analysis

propositions.proposition_es: La adjudicación puede producir un perjuicio nuevo antes de cualquier cesión, al debilitar la legitimación y dificultar restitución, contabilidad y continuidad de remedios.
propositions.proposition_en: Adjudication may create a new injury before any cession by weakening standing and impairing restitution, accounting and continuity of remedies.
propositions.missing_discriminator: Current adjudication status and remedy-specific legal analysis

propositions.proposition_es: El adjudicatario formal, el cesionario formal y el beneficiario real o terminal deben registrarse por separado.
propositions.proposition_en: The formal adjudicatee, formal assignee and real or terminal beneficiary must be recorded separately.
propositions.missing_discriminator: Formal recipient, principal/UBO, consideration, communications and post-transfer use

propositions.proposition_es: Matkator sostiene que la falta de restitución hasta la fecha deriva de actuaciones y omisiones impugnadas y no demuestra que la restitución sea imposible.
propositions.proposition_en: Matkator maintains that the lack of restitution to date results from challenged acts and omissions and does not show that restitution is impossible.
propositions.missing_discriminator: Actor-specific decisions, causation and competent judicial findings

propositions.proposition_es: La finca 8584 no pertenece a la masa de LPB, pero su transferencia puede tener consecuencias sobre unidad productiva, valoración, reclamaciones, recuperación y rendición de cuentas del Concurso 36/2012.
propositions.proposition_en: Finca 8584 is not part of LPB's estate, but its transfer may have productive-unit, valuation, claims, recovery and accountability consequences for Concurso 36/2012.

propositions.proposition_es: La historia del mandato hace pertinente reconstruir el conocimiento individual de Cuatrecasas, pero no permite imputar automáticamente conocimiento o dolo a cada profesional posterior.
propositions.proposition_en: The mandate history makes individual Cuatrecasas knowledge relevant, but does not automatically impute knowledge or intent to each later professional.
propositions.missing_discriminator: Individual/team receipt, role, filing and decision chronology

legal_person_boundary: Matkator is distinct from LPB and Aweswell
LPB estate is not the whole hotel
CAM, HNT, Canarian Hospitality and RICPE are distinct entities
Physical and economic continuity does not prove collective criminal intent
